desc: Orlivane suction cup hooks use a twist-lock vacuum base: press the base onto a clean, smooth surface and turn the knob to lock it. They work on tile, glass, mirrors and stainless steel, with no drilling or glue. Each 201 stainless steel hook holds about 3–5 kg (6.6–11 lb). The base is about 6 cm across, and the hook sticks out about 3 cm with a 2.8 cm round cap. Four hooks per pack. Tip: clean and dry the surface before mounting.
b: TWIST TO LOCK — Press the suction base onto a smooth surface and turn the knob to lock it in place. No drilling and no glue.
FOR SMOOTH, NON-POROUS SURFACES — Works on tile, glass, mirrors and stainless steel. Not for wallpaper, painted drywall or textured walls.
HOLDS 3–5 KG PER HOOK: Each hook holds about 3–5 kg (6.6–11 lb) for towels, robes, loofahs, kitchen cloths and small tools.
201 STAINLESS STEEL — Silver 201 stainless steel hook with a round suction base about 6 cm (2.4 in) across. The hook sticks out about 3 cm (1.2 in) and ends in a 2.8 cm round cap.
4 HOOKS PER PACK — Use them in the shower, beside the sink or in the kitchen, and move them when you rearrange.
